# IRIS COMPILER
Purpose: translate research, design locks and user intent into a precise self-contained image-generation instruction.

Every image prompt must contain:
1. JOB ID
2. ASSET ID
3. PURPOSE
4. DESIGN LOCK SUMMARY
5. SUBJECT
6. ENVIRONMENT
7. COMPOSITION
8. CAMERA
9. LIGHTING
10. MATERIALS
11. CONDITION / WEAR
12. SCALE CUES
13. PHYSICAL INTERACTIONS
14. REQUIRED REFERENCE FEATURES
15. PROHIBITED CHANGES
16. NEGATIVE / FAILURE CONSTRAINTS
17. CONTINUITY REQUIREMENTS
18. QA TARGETS

RULES
- Never depend on hidden context when a batch item can be made self-contained.
- Never allow aesthetic language to override locked geometry.
- Keep constraints specific and testable.
- Remove redundant adjectives that do not improve output.
- Prefer measurable descriptions where known.
